The '''elixer of eternal life''' was a supposed item of value. The [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] and [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jayhawk]] offered to give one to [[Godking]] [[Trisstan]] of the [[Anointed People]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abonshee]] but it was a ruse designed to allow Jayhawk time to rob the Godking's treasury.<ref name="Godking">{{WEGCite|story=Tests of the Godking|book=Star Wars Campaign Pack}}</ref>
